correctness.rationale: The sink-burning criterion on a fan gives the recurrent words characterized by every pair of zeros having a two between them (endpoints allow 0,1; interior 0,1,2). Saturated vertices form maximal contiguous path runs; adding at a saturated vertex topples every vertex in its run once and no other vertex, while an unsaturated addition topples none, by a direct chip-height check. A marked-run transfer decomposition gives M(z,t)=z^2 t/(1-tz)*(t+B(z)), B=(2-5z+2z^2)/(1-3z+z^2)^2, and t∂_tM counts positive avalanche sizes; subtracting from zR′(z) determines zero events. Dominant pole at z=alpha^-1 and Fibonacci recurrent counts give the normalized limiting masses. An independent direct sandpile burning and stabilization implementation enumerated every stable configuration for n=2..9 and verified every polynomial coefficient; for n=4 exactly 38+22t+14t^2+6t^3+4t^4. The transfer identity is an exact rational identity described by source proof, not inferred from finite tests.
